scope: Repair verified survey literal source closure and observe silent-lesson recovery in one DOM observation.
implementation: One bounded literal-import scan shared by Node manifest creation and browser legacy source verification excludes JSDoc imports, comments and quoted examples. Node cross-checks every fresh source hash against compiler syntax; unsupported syntax refuses rather than publishing a differing edge set. This is not a general ECMAScript parser or a contract for computed loaders.

The bounded1024-file Node cache owns only frozen compiler-checked import strings indexed by filename and fresh SHA256. Every manifest still reads and hashes current file bytes, and reports loaded execution as unbound. It does not cache source proof by mtime or reuse an execution identity.

Silent lesson test retains real transport and output, observes all status DOM atoms together and activates the actual current DOM recovery button in the same observation. This scripted DOM activation is explicitly not native pointer qualification. Native host-gap stop stays250ms.
